title: Sales call (3 speakers, hand-off)

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Thanks for making time, Tom. Today I want to walk through pricing and the security review.

segments.speaker: Tom
segments.text: Our main concern is single sign-on. Our IT team requires SAML for every vendor.

segments.speaker: Dev
segments.text: We support SAML with Okta and Azure AD today, and SCIM provisioning is on the roadmap for March.

segments.speaker: Tom
segments.text: Good. Legal will also need your SOC 2 report before we can sign.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Dev, can you send Tom the SOC 2 report and the security questionnaire?

segments.speaker: Dev
segments.text: Sure, I'll get both over by Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Tom
segments.text: On pricing, we'd need annual billing and a discount above two hundred seats.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: I'll put together an annual quote for two hundred and fifty seats.

summary:
## Summary
- Tom said their IT team requires SAML for every vendor.
- Priya said SCIM provisioning is on the roadmap for March.
- Tom asked for annual billing and a discount above two hundred seats.
## Action items
- Priya: send Tom the SOC 2 report and security questionnaire by Wednesday.
- Dev: prepare an annual quote for two hundred and fifty seats.
- Dev: schedule a demo of SCIM for the IT team next week.
